people.name: daughter1_of_Lot
people.line: Elder daughter of Lot; mother of Moab

translations.web: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.
translations.bsb: The older daughter gave birth to a son and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites of today.
translations.kjv: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
translations.asv: And the first-born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
